entry.title: Stability of digital and analog quantum simulations under noise
entry.content:
Authors: J Eisert, J Rao, T Guaita

Journal: 2026

Abstract: Quantum simulation is a central application of near-term quantum devices, pursued in both analog and digital architectures. A key challenge for both paradigms is the effect of imperfections and noise on predictive power. In this work, we present a ...
